TYPE workout

NUTRITION
  CALORIES:
    target "energy deficit 300..500 kcal/day to lose ~0.3..0.5 kg/week; adjust if fasting glucose <80 mg/dL or symptomatic"
  MACROS:
    protein "1.6 g/kg/day (spread across 3..4 meals)"
    carbs "1.5..2.0 g/kg/day prioritizing low-GI, high-fiber sources"
    fat "balance remainder, ~0.8 g/kg/day, emphasize unsaturated fats"
    fiber "25..35 g/day from vegetables, legumes, berries, oats, chia"
  MEAL_TIMING:
    pre_workout "10..20 g low-GI carbs + 20..30 g protein 60..90 min pre; if fasting glucose <90 mg/dL add 10 g extra carbs"
    post_workout "25..35 g protein + 30..45 g carbs within 2 hours; choose low-GI (oats, quinoa, beans, berries)"
    breakfast "high-protein, high-fiber; avoid fruit juice and refined grains"
    evening "prioritize non-starchy veg + lean protein; portion-controlled carbs"
  FOOD_GUIDANCE:
    carbs_sources "oats, quinoa, barley, brown rice, whole-wheat pasta, legumes, lentils, beans, sweet potato, berries, apples, pears"
    protein_sources "fish, poultry, lean beef, eggs, greek yogurt, cottage cheese, tofu, tempeh"
    fat_sources "olive oil, nuts, seeds, avocado, fatty fish"
    avoid "sugary drinks, refined sweets, ultra-processed snacks, excessive alcohol"
    hydration "2.0..2.5 L water/day; with cardio add 500 ml/hour"
  DIABETES_NOTES:
    monitoring "check fasting glucose daily; check pre-workout and post-workout initially; carry rapid-acting carbs (glucose tabs) for readings <70 mg/dL"
    metformin "take as prescribed; no exercise-specific adjustment typically needed"
    hypoglycemia_plan "if <70 mg/dL and symptomatic: pause, take 15 g fast carbs, recheck in 15 min; resume only when >90 mg/dL"
    foot_care "wear proper footwear; inspect feet daily"
  WEEKLY_HABITS:
    steps "7,000..10,000 steps/day"
    sleep "7..9 hours/night"
    alcohol "max 0..1 drink/day, not daily"
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    meal1 "omelet with spinach + feta; oats with chia and berries; coffee unsweetened"
    meal2 "greek yogurt + walnuts + cinnamon; apple"
    meal3 "grilled chicken, quinoa, mixed greens, olive oil vinaigrette"
    meal4 "salmon, roasted vegetables, lentils"
    snacks "carrot sticks, cottage cheese, almonds"
  ADJUSTMENTS:
    plateau "if weight loss stalls 2 weeks: reduce carbs by 0.2 g/kg/day or add 10 minutes to two cardio sessions"
    low_energy "add 150 kcal from protein/veg; reassess sleep and stress"
    high_glucose "if fasting >130 mg/dL for 1 week: shift carbs toward breakfast/lunch, add 10 minutes walking after dinner"
    premenstrual "increase carbs +150 kcal/day from oats/fruit; maintain protein"
